rule: Visit levels in order. Run two repetitions on each of two calibration tasks. If successes and failures both appear, run two further repetitions per task at that level, then stop when a single task has both rewards. If still homogeneous within each task, advance. All attempted stages are retained. No evaluation cases are generated until the selected difficulty is recorded.
success_condition: At least one completed Sol reward 1 and one completed Sol reward 0 on the same calibrated task. Transport and incomplete outcomes do not qualify.
freshness: All fictional numeric records generated on 2026-10-24; task wording by Claude Opus 5.5. Evaluation seeds disjoint from calibration.
